feedback_rules.description: Distinguish between out-of-sync errors and stylistic variations
Camera cannot assess internal timing; focus on visible synchronization

learning_units.description: Learn basic ballroom steps in formation and maintain synchronization
Practice transitions between geometric patterns like diamonds and circles
Execute chain reactions and roundabout figures with timing

prerequisites.description: Basic ballroom dance technique and partner connection
Ability to maintain timing and spatial awareness in a group

social_formats.description: Teams of 6-8 couples dancing in geometric formations with shared rhythm

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Held in ballroom frame; coordinated with partner and team
movement_profile.footwork: Precise steps matching dance style; synchronized with team
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Geometric patterns with clear spacing; transitions between shapes
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Movement follows dance style; Latin dances have more hip action
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Intermediate to advanced complexity; jumps not described
movement_profile.partnering: Couples dance in closed ballroom hold; solo sections allowed in Latin
movement_profile.posture: Upright ballroom posture with poised upper body

signature_moves.description: Sequential movement passed through the team creating a wave effect
signature_moves.name: Chain Reaction

signature_moves.description: Couples rotate in a circular pattern around a point
signature_moves.name: Roundabout

signature_moves.description: A specific formation figure unique to formation dance
signature_moves.name: Velberter Rose

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Strict tempo adherence; rhythmic precision critical
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Lifts during judged routine Out-of-sync movements Breaking formation patterns

music_profile.meter: Varies by dance; Latin dances often in 4/4, Waltz in 3/4
music_profile.musical_form: Music arranged in three parts: entrance, main judged section, and exit, separated by a gong
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Characteristic rhythms of each dance (e.g., Cha Cha syncopated steps, Waltz flowing 3/4)
music_profile.tempo_bpm: Varies by dance style; e.g., Cha Cha ~120 bpm, Waltz ~84 bpm

basic_steps: Couples line up in formation (e.g., diamond or line)
Start synchronized basic steps of chosen dance (e.g., Cha Cha basic step)
Execute coordinated turns or chain reactions on beat
Transition smoothly to next formation pattern
Walk off formation in coordinated exit
teaching.formation: Teams of 6-8 couples arranged in geometric patterns such as diamonds, circles, lines, or squares
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start with basic steps and simple formations; advanced dancers perform complex patterns and solo sections
teaching.rhythm: Strict adherence to the beat and meter of the chosen dance style; synchronization is essential

platform: Validated voice/movement feedback and accessible controls
Human BDF consent/matching, moderation and measured session synchronization
Tested camera/split-screen delivery; AR remains an optional future adapter
